in_marathi.name: Anveta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anveta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anveta means pure and serene. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu' which means near and 'veta' which means cow. The name is given to the calf born just before the main calf in a cow's delivery. It signifies the purity of the newborn and the serene environment of its birth. In Hinduism, the cow is considered a symbol of prosperity and fertility, making Anveta a name with deep spiritual significance.
